In Surah Al-Qasas (28:67), Allah states, "Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad) a manifest victory. You shall call upon the Night and lo! it is the word of truth. Therein is peace until the emergence of dawn." So, Laal symbolizes the spiritual tranquility and the peace of the night, which carries religious and spiritual significance.
